LIFE-203: Duplicate families in the registry

Some families are registered twice, under slightly different spellings of the same name
("Mohamed Ali" and "Muhammad Ali"). They are getting double rations. Some of the duplicate
records were typed in before IDs were checked at registration, so their household IDs
are mistyped.

Ask: write a one-time script, scripts/merge_duplicates.py, and run it once. It finds the
households that are really the same family and merges each group into one record: keep
the record whose household ID is valid, and mark the other record as merged into it.

Done when: each real family has exactly one active record, the kept record has a valid
ID, no record is deleted, and no other record is changed.
